answer.origin: finance.yahoo.com article dated 2026-07-01 reporting NN, Inc.'s late-June 2026 announcement; NN is the original speaker and the announcement day is not stated in the supplied records.
answer.note: The covered company is NVIDIA (NVDA), which is only indirectly connected to this source. The source reports that NN, Inc., a supplier, is adding 47 machine centers at its Wuxi, China plant for liquid cooling production for NVIDIA AI data center racks. It also reports NN's claim that 100% of the new capacity is pre-sold under multi-year, multi-product awards, and an NN target of US$80–90 million of new business in 2026. As a supplier-side report, this is a supply-chain lead, not proof of NVIDIA's purchases. Conditional interpretation: if the pre-sold awards are for NVIDIA rack programs, NVIDIA's rack-level liquid cooling supply in Asia is expanding through NN during 2026 onward. Counterexample: all quoted facts could hold while NVIDIA is not the buyer, for example if the awards are with other data center customers using similar racks. That premise is missing. The NN 2028 revenue and earnings projections, the unnamed analyst estimates, and the Russell Microcap Value Index removal concern NN's own business and stock, so they do not inform NVIDIA's revenue, demand or competition.
limitations: The buyer of the pre-sold awards is not identified in the supplied records, so NVIDIA as direct purchaser is unconfirmed.
Award values, contract terms and the basis of the US$80–90 million target (revenue or bookings) are not disclosed; the target is an NN party statement.
The start date and output timing for the 47 machine centers are not stated.
No NVIDIA-side statement confirming this program or supplier relationship appears in the supplied records.
The 2028 projections and unnamed analyst estimates describe NN, not NVIDIA, and are not used for NVIDIA conclusions.
follow_up: Check NN's later earnings release, press release or 8-K for award counterparties, contract values and whether NVIDIA is named as a customer.
Check NVIDIA's 10-Q, 10-K and supplier or customer disclosures for any mention of NN or Wuxi liquid cooling supply.
Check NN's Wuxi capacity timing and any customer qualification or production start announcements for the 47 machine centers.
